notes: Reference prices and maximum stock are client-table values, not live quotes or current post stock.
Current buy price, destination profit, and stock must be entered by the user.
Barter recipes and guarantee effects are imported from client tables; ingredient/letter market values and owned counts remain user inputs.
Barter weekly sourceCount is shown as a per-week cap from the client table; the assumed one barter output per exchange should be confirmed in game.
The client has no barter rotation schedule; every grade-1 rotating alternative is imported, isDefaultRotation marks the last confirmed one, and the app selects the active one manually or from a scan.

products.name: Baby Potion
products.description: A purified potion that is safe for children. It doesn't restore HP, but it tastes fruity!

products.name: Diet Potion
products.description: A potion that helps people lose weight. Drink it right before working out. This potion has jumped in popularity recently.

products.name: Snore Prevention Potion
products.description: Pour this potion on a plate next to your bed before sleeping. It will produce a pungent smell that expands your nostrils, preventing you from snoring. Just remember to air your bedroom out the next day.

products.name: Wild Ginseng Potion
products.description: A potion made with a rare wild ginseng from the mountain behind Tir Chonaill. It restores Strength and has other beneficial effects. Be careful of giving to someone with a high body temperature.

products.name: Lovely Potion
products.description: A potion that brings true love between the two that drink it. Only works if your intended lover does not know what it is.

products.name: Spider Gloves
products.description: Special gloves made for gathering cobwebs. They are coated to prevent the cobwebs from sticking.

products.name: Wool Boots
products.description: Special boots with sound-insulated soles. Makes it easier to sneak up on sheep.

products.name: Ogre Executioner Mask
products.description: A mask that resembles an Ogre Executioner. Often worn for self-defense at night.

products.name: Incubus Suit
products.description: A suit perfect for attracting attention. The Red Incubus Suit is popular these days.

products.name: Succubus Swimsuit
products.description: A swimsuit for Succubi that are only ever seen at noblemens' auctions, for some reason.They are very rare and rumored to attract Succubi, though perhaps not for the reason one might hope.

products.name: Bangor Coal
products.description: A mineral used as fuel. It's a little heavy.

products.name: Marble
products.description: A slick white stone. It's often used for floor tiling in luxurious mansions. Tara Royal Castle purchased all marble produced in the last 7 years.

products.name: Topaz
products.description: A yellow crystal. Decorate your windows with topaz to make your room yellow, just like Lileas's hair, and give it a warm feel.

products.name: Highlander Ore
products.description: An ore that is synonymous with the weapons it is used to make, such as the Highlander Claymore. Blacksmiths like Ferghus have worked tirelessly to craft better weapons with this ore, but no one has discovered its true potential yet.

products.name: Lead
products.description: The world's heaviest metal. It is too soft to make weapons or armor from, but it has been researched exhaustively by Alchemists such as Leymore and Cai, trying to find a way to transmute it into gold.

products.name: Berry Granola
products.description: A berry-granola mixture, baked in an oven. You can eat it with milk or as a dry snack.

products.name: Butter Beer
products.description: A soft beer made with Emain Macha Butter. Even though it's called beer, it doesn't contain alcohol, so anybody can drink it.

products.name: Smoked Wild Animal
products.description: The leg of some beast, wrapped in silver and smoked over an open fire. Whatever it is, it's pretty chewy.

products.name: Triple Pasta
products.description: Pasta made with white mushrooms. Since white mushrooms are so rare, this dish is a highly-valued delicacy.

products.name: Whole BBQ Bear
products.description: Cooked bear from Emain Macha. To make this, you must tie the bear to a tree trunk, and cook it for a whole day while five strong men rotate it constantly. Definitely worth the effort, though.

products.name: Heat Crystal
products.description: A crystal made by compounding Fire and Wind Crystals. You can use it in cylinders, or as a heat pack.

products.name: Music Box Preservation Stone
products.description: This stone plays a saved sound when it is struck. Only works once.

products.name: Palala Crystal
products.description: A crystal that shines incredibly brightly for an instant when used in a cylinder. Excellent for blinding enemies. Just don't forget to cover your own eyes.

products.name: Circle Barrier Spikes Crystal
products.description: A crystal that creates a circular protective barrier around you. Try using it when you need some time alone.

products.name: Alchemy Crystal
products.description: A crystal that can change a small life form into gold. However, it always creates less gold than it takes to make the crystal. Used to make gold beetles or gold minnows. Has no effect on large life forms such as dogs or humans.

products.name: Mini Dressing Table
products.description: A dressing table used by women. It's small enough for anyone to use.

products.name: Tea Table
products.description: A table made specifically for enjoying a cup of tea. It is round, with engraved patterns adorning its surface.

products.name: Rocking Chair
products.description: A rocking chair with a fluffy cushion, filled with cotton. Sitting in it for more than a few minutes will put you out for the night.

products.name: Bunk Bed
products.description: A bunk bed with stairs, made with consideration of children's safety. It's low enough that you can fall off and still be fine.

products.name: Giant Wine Rack
products.description: A huge rack for storing wine bottles. A collector's item due to its large size.

products.name: Cobh Seaweed
products.description: Seaweed that tastes good no matter how you cook it. Soggy seaweed gets stuck on the roof of your mouth, so be careful.

products.name: Cobh Oyster
products.description: A shellfish with a unique smell. It is said that Edern eats them to stay healthy.

products.name: Shark Fin
products.description: Part of the shark that's popular not for its taste, but for its rarity. Since it's hard to catch a shark at all, this remains an extremely rare dish.

products.name: Jellyfish
products.description: A jellyfish. Since it's so slippery, it will go straight down your throat even if you don't chew. Don't forget to clean it before eating!

products.name: Neid Scales
products.description: Scales dropped by Neid. You can obtain a few by pouring some water from Lake Neagh into the waters of Port Cobh. This will make the scales shine. Many consider the scales to be a symbol of luck.

products.name: Iron Whip
products.description: An iron whip used to train horses. Just like a morning star, it has linked chains.

products.name: Dark Sword
products.description: A black-bladed sword. Looks like an ordinary one-handed sword, just black.

products.name: Safe
products.description: A small safe crafted of solid steel, used for storing precious objects. Ordinary beings can't even move this thing.

products.name: Skeleton Ogre Armor
products.description: Armor worn by the Skeleton Ogre. Since it's too heavy for humans, it's used more as a decoration than for battle purposes. It is said the wearer can have superhuman strength, but they probably had it just to be able to wear it at all.

products.name: Fake Morgant Helmet
products.description: A helmet that looks like just like Dark Lord Morgant's helmet. Don't expect it to have the same power, though!

products.name: Ocean Tear
products.description: A formation of coral and pearl that evokes the beauty of the ocean.

products.name: Alluring Stem
products.description: A tough, smooth stem.Most flora taken from the Forest of Temptation crumbles quickly, so rare samples like this are highly sought after.

products.name: Abyss Crystal
products.description: You feel like you might get sucked into the blackness of this crystal. Infusing it with mana can create many colorful effects, making this a valuable decorative piece.

products.name: Sage Crystals
products.description: A bottle of colorless crystals. These can be used to enhance the quality of other alchemy crystals, regardless of attributes or effects.

products.name: River's Source
products.description: A blue, viscous liquid. Adding this to potions will give them a little extra kick.

products.name: Night Sky Leather
products.description: Leather that shines in the dark. Looking into this is like looking into the night sky. Used in high quality outfits.

products.name: Unidentified Fish
products.description: Unidentifiable fish from the deep seas. Highly valued among collectors.

products.name: Crystal Blade
products.description: A long, thin, cracked blade made out of crystal. Used as a decoration, not a weapon; the longer, the better.

products.name: Mint Chocolate Powder
products.description: No one can resist this popular flavor.There's an old saying that those who like mint chocolate are always right.Enjoy it with chicken or pizza, or maybe just make a milkshake if you're more normal.

products.name: Fresh Pomegranate
products.description: Widely used as a material for tea and dyes due to its unique scent and color.

products.name: Mana Tunnel Figure
products.description: A miniature reproduction of a Mana Tunnel that can fit in your palm.It even replicates the effect of activating the tunnel when you bring your hand close.

products.name: Exploration Rescue Kit
products.description: A portable first-aid kit is essential for travel in Iria, which is known for its rough terrain and ever-shifting climate.

products.name: Kaypi Cactus Essence
products.description: An essence used in skin care products.Produced in Iria, where survival is paramount, you can even consume it for sustenance should the need arise.

products.name: Building Lumber
products.description: Unprocessed lumber that, once processed, is used extensively in construction projects of all sorts.

products.name: Ancient Fossil Specimen
products.description: Fossils of creatures long extinct, found near the Muyu Desert.Those in good condition are used for research purposes.

products.name: Personal Camping Tent
products.description: A lightweight camping set that comes with a tent and small, simple camping tools.Particularly useful when traveling alone.

products.name: Lutra Freshwater Eel
products.description: Caught only with a permit and in limited numbers, Lutra freshwater eels are only used for the finest cuisine due to their notable rarity.

products.name: Kaypi Red Clay
products.description: Red clay that can be gathered in Kaypi Canyon.Refined several times, it is especially fine-grained and soft to the touch and is widely used in cosmetics and the crafting of ceramics.

products.name: Small Glass Chunk
products.description: A piece of naturally occurring glass often found on the beaches near Filia.Although not particularly rare, they're often used for decorative purposes and costume jewelry due to their wide varieties of colors and shapes.

products.name: Cinnamon Perfume
products.description: An enticing, slightly spicy fragrance.Even if you've been wandering the perilous desert for days on end, at least you won't have to worry about smelling bad.

products.name: Dried Saffron
products.description: Well-dried saffron prized by culinary aficionados as a luxury spice.

products.name: Longa Natural Rock Salt
products.description: Rock salt mined on the rocky outskirts of the Longa Desert.Most of it ends up refined for use in seasoning food, but there's also some industrial demand.

products.name: Filia-Style Jerky
products.description: Jerky made using the traditional Filia-style air-curing method.It's dried just right, keeping its savory flavor without being too tough.

products.name: Sun Hourglass
products.description: An hourglass produced as a specialty of Filia.While it has no special function, it's quite popular as a souvenir with visitors to the region.

products.name: Shyllien Icebox
products.description: A box that keeps food cool.Having one may be a luxury during one's adventures, but is always appreciated when it keeps things from spoiling.Its mana needs to be periodically replenished for it to maintain its chilly temperature.

products.name: Desert-Terrain Wheel
products.description: Suitable for use in deserts and other sandy environments, this thick, sturdy wheel won't sink into the sand due to its wide outer edge.

products.name: Filia Traditional Carpet
products.description: A rug woven with a traditional pattern long used in the Filia region.Softer than it looks, it feels nice to sit on.It doesn't fly, though (except, perhaps, in your imagination).

products.name: Gem Parasol
products.description: A parasol adorned with colorful gems that has proven a popular item with collectors of luxury goods.It has been waterproofed and so can be used as an umbrella, but most would rather employ a cheaper solution to fend off the wind and rain.

products.name: Courcle Ruins Souvenir
products.description: An inexpensive but detailed travel souvenir fashioned in the likeness of the relics of Cor.In the past, real relics and curios from the ruins were sold on the collector's market, but this practice has largely been discontinued due to a desire to preserve the ruins, as well as the ethical issues surrounding the removal of historical items from the region.

products.name: Large Ritual Mask
products.description: A fairly large mask that's often used in the traditional rituals of Courcle.Their unique shape has lead to them becoming popular decorations in other regions.

products.name: La Terra Raspberry
products.description: A variety of raspberry that grows only in the La Terra Highlands.It has a high sugar content and good nutritional value.

products.name: Artifact Restoration Tool Set
products.description: A set of expertly made artifact restoration tools so reliable that they can be used to restore even artifacts requiring very delicate work.A practiced hand is still required, though: it is rumored among restoration enthusiasts that someone from Tir Chonaill managed to completely destroy a rare, ancient weapon even using this kit.

products.name: Courcle Natural Rubber
products.description: Natural rubber produced manually in small batches.It trades at a high price due to its quality, low supply, and variety of uses.

products.name: Lipai Pattern Textile
products.description: A textile delicately embroidered with a pattern based on flowers that only bloom in Cor.While light and soft, it is surprisingly durable and resistant to tearing.

products.name: Cor Honeycomb
products.description: Honey produced in the Courcle region is famous for its quality.This popular and highly marketable product is sold all over Erinn.

products.name: Swamp Ash
products.description: Swamp ash wood is less prone to deformation when properly sourced and dried.It is prized for use in making furniture due to its beautiful grain.

products.name: Rosewood
products.description: Rosewood with an impressive, distinctive color.It has nothing to do with roses, despite its name.Because its high density gives it excellent acoustics, it is often used in the crafting of musical instruments.

products.name: Ebony
products.description: The jet-black interior of ebony wood gives it a very posh, luxurious look.It's classified as a rare wood, so only a limited amount is logged each year.

products.name: Vales Padded Coat
products.description: It's likely that every resident of Vales has at least one of these coats, known the world over for being both lightweight and warm even in the harshest cold.

products.name: Natural Glacial Water
products.description: Pure water sourced from glacial ice in the Physis region.It is so well-packaged that even after being boiled down, you think you can still feel its refreshing coolness.

products.name: Ice Skates
products.description: A pair of ice skates made by Taunes and Zeder as a side job.They consist of sturdy, sharpened blades attached to warm and breathable boots.The craftsmen are a bit embarrassed that this side business brings in more money than their regular work.

products.name: Snowboard
products.description: A snowboard made for quick travel across snowfields or riding down snow-covered mountains for sport.Made of thoughtfully chosen materials, it's both strong and flexible.

products.name: Vales Vodka
products.description: Drink this finest vodka alongside a bear.Those who have succeeded claim the bears actually appreciate it.

products.name: Calida Flint
products.description: Calida flint is known for its high quality and long-lasting usefulness.It's used not only in the lighting of hot air balloons, but also for general heating.

products.name: Physis Sled
products.description: The most widely used means of transportation in Physis.One would think its uses limited to frozen ground, but surprisingly, there's a healthy demand for them in other regions.

products.name: Portable Hand Warmer
products.description: A hand warmer made with the principles of Hillwen engineering.It gives off a cozy amount of warmth for a long time without any need for oil or mana.

products.name: Ice Statue
products.description: An ice statue often used as a showpiece for big events.It's been specially treated so it doesn't melt easily and can maintain its shape.

products.name: Hillwen Commemorative Coin
products.description: A limited edition commemorative coin made of Hillwen ore.Similar coins have been criticized in the past for being overproduced, so now only limited amounts are minted, making them a true collectible.

products.name: Wooden Table
products.description: A table made with the wood of a huge tree.Enjoy its beautiful grain and uniquely pleasant aroma.

products.name: Wooden Craft
products.description: A figurine fashioned in the likeness of one found in the Rano region's ruins.Though not of any inherently great value, they're popular as souvenirs for those visiting the region.

products.name: Stone Horse Statue
products.description: A statue designed to accurately depict the dynamic appearance of the Stone Horse.Rumor has it that it'll be used to promote a jousting tournament.

products.name: Karu Shiitake Mushroom
products.description: A special variety of shiitake mushroom that grows only in the Karu Forest.It is said to be more delicious and nutritious than normal shiitake mushrooms.

products.name: Shellfish Fossil
products.description: A shellfish fossil found in the Muyu Desert area.It speaks to the memories of the distant past, when the Muyu Desert was an inland sea.

products.name: Fine Sand
products.description: Sand collected from the Rupes Desert area, of a very fine and silky grain.It has many uses.

products.name: Prison Ghost Wings
products.description: The wings of one of the Prison Ghosts that appear in the Metus region.Often used for decoration due to their sleek appearance.

products.name: Oasis Painting
products.description: A framed painting of the beautiful scenery of an oasis.There seems to be ongoing demand for these artworks thanks to the exotic locale they depict.

products.name: Cactus Flower
products.description: Cactus flowers that will bloom for a long time without withering, even without special care.The petals can be dried and steeped to make a tea with a deep, rich fragrance.

products.name: Giant Canine Fossil
products.description: The fossilized canine of a huge unknown animal.Some suggest it could be a dragon's tooth, but no one can really confirm it.

products.name: Elvan Egg
products.description: Perhaps the most popular food among those bathing in hot springs.Hot springs and elvan eggs go together like chocolate and mint.

products.name: Calida Salmon
products.description: Whether raw, smoked, or grilled, Calida salmon is delicious no matter how you eat it.

products.name: Hot Spring Bath Bomb
products.description: A bath bomb that creates a rich foam reputed to keep your skin smooth and tight.Surprisingly, its all-natural ingredients mean the bathwater is safe for the environment.

products.name: Large Camping Tent
products.description: A camping tent known for its great durability and reliability.With this helpful shelter, you can camp comfortably anywhere in Erinn.

products.name: Pink Salt
products.description: Salt produced in small quantities with strict quality control.It has almost no bitterness, and its mild, savory taste lingers in your mouth.

products.name: Volcanic Mud Pack
products.description: A mud pack made of fine soil from a volcanic region.Spread the paste-like mud on your face to rejuvenate your skin and liven up your complexion.

products.name: Magma Stone
products.description: A magma stone hardened while imbued with mana, remaining warm for a very long time.When all the mana it holds is exhausted, it becomes no different from a normal stone.

products.name: Ixion Horn
products.description: The horn of an Ixion, a rare creature encountered in volcanic regions.It is often used as a material for expensive crafts because of its beautiful shape and the ease of working with it.

products.name: Volcano Lizard Egg
products.description: It is said that Volcano Lizards can be tamed if you hatch their eggs and raise them by hand.Few, however, seem to have put in the effort to try it themselves.

products.name: Raspa Black Leopard Leather
products.description: The leather of Black Leopards, which occasionally appear in volcanic regions, is highly valued due to the big cats' relative rarity.

barterProducts.name: Intro to Ruin Exploration

barterProducts.name: Sun Pottery

barterProducts.name: Lake Calida Painting

barterProducts.name: Large Hammock
barterProducts.description: A hammock where you can rest near the hot springs. It's sturdy and spacious, providing comfort.

barterProducts.name: Hot Spring Water Diffuser
barterProducts.description: A diffuser with the scent of hot spring water. It fills the space with a subtle fragrance.

barterProducts.name: Water Spirit Statue
barterProducts.description: A statue fashioned in the likeness of a Water Spirit. It features clean, smooth curves.

barterProducts.name: Amber Gemstone Shard
barterProducts.description: A polished piece of amber mined from the Calida Region. Its warm colors make it suitable for decoration.

barterProducts.name: Calida Salmon
barterProducts.description: Whether raw, smoked, or grilled, Calida salmon is delicious any way you slice it.

barterProducts.name: Elvan Egg
barterProducts.description: Perhaps the most popular food among hot spring visitors. Hot springs and elvan eggs go together like mint and chocolate.

barterProducts.name: Dragon Fan
barterProducts.description: A fancy fan carved with a Dragon Crest. Its flame-shaped decoration is impressive.

barterProducts.name: Volcanic Ash Medicine
barterProducts.description: A medicine made by refining volcanic ash. It is used for skin-soothing or cosmetic purposes.

barterProducts.name: Fire Crystal Ball
barterProducts.description: A crystal ball housing a Spirit of the Fire. A dim red light swirls within.

barterProducts.name: Red Koi Sculpture
barterProducts.description: A statue shaped like a reddish fish. It represents the harmony of water and fire.

barterProducts.name: Lava Thermometer
barterProducts.description: A thermometer crafted to measure the heat of lava. Made of a special material that can withstand high temperatures.

barterProducts.name: Raspa Black Leopard Leather
barterProducts.description: The leather of Black Leopards, which occasionally appear in volcanic regions, is highly valued due to the big cats' relative rarity.

barterProducts.name: Volcano Lizard Egg

barterProducts.name: Ixion Horn
barterProducts.description: The horn of an Ixion, a rare creature encountered in volcanic regions. Beautifully shaped and easy to work with, it is often used as a material for expensive crafts.

barterProducts.name: Magma Stone

barterProducts.name: Volcanic Mud Pack
barterProducts.description: A mud pack made of fine soil from a volcanic region. Spread the paste-like mud on your face to rejuvenate your skin and liven up your complexion.

barterMaterials.name: Poison Tip Wyvern Ballista Bolt
barterMaterials.description: A giant bolt that can be used with the Ballista.\nA Wyvern Claw has been dipped in poison so that the wounded will be poisoned. If there is force backing it, it can become more powerful.

barterMaterials.name: Wheat Flour
barterMaterials.description: Flour made from ground wheat.

barterMaterials.name: Barley Flour
barterMaterials.description: Flour made from ground barley.

barterMaterials.name: Shrimp Taming Bait
barterMaterials.description: Shrimp bait that smells both sweet and garlicy.\nIt's more effective at taming wild animals than other baits.

barterMaterials.name: Spirit Liqueur
barterMaterials.description: An important potion used to repair Spirit items. Contains metal-like solutions.

barterMaterials.name: HP 500 Potion
barterMaterials.description: A potion for quick HP recovery. Cannot be used while knocked down, and cannot cure wounds. Excessive use may result in medicinal poisoning.\nPress <hotkey name="UseLifePotion"/> to use a potion from your inventory, starting from the bottom right.

barterMaterials.name: MP 500 Potion
barterMaterials.description: A potion for quick MP recovery. Cannot be used while knocked down. Excessive use may result in medicinal poisoning.\nPress <hotkey name="UseManaPotion"/> to use a potion from your inventory, starting from the bottom right.

barterMaterials.name: Stamina 500 Potion
barterMaterials.description: A potion for quick Stamina recovery. Cannot be used while knocked down, and cannot recover stamina lost due to hunger. Excessive use may result in medicinal poisoning.\nPress <hotkey name="UseStaminaPotion"/> to use a potion from your inventory, starting from the bottom right.

barterMaterials.name: Marionette 500 Potion
barterMaterials.description: A potion capable of instantly repairing a damaged marionette. Over-application may result in lasting damage to the puppet, but such damage can be repaired with the proper tools. Cannot be used while the puppet is knocked out, knocked down, or being knocked back.\n\nPress <hotkey name="UseMarionettePotion"/> to use this item from your inventory, starting from bottom right.

barterMaterials.name: Braid
barterMaterials.description: A braid made by intertwining different kinds of thread so that they wouldn't come undone.

barterMaterials.name: Fine Silk
barterMaterials.description: Its official name is Spider Silk. Its soft texture and slight sheen are valued far more than any ordinary fabric. This high-quality silk has been very intricately woven.

barterMaterials.name: Finest Silk
barterMaterials.description: Its official name is Spider Silk. Its soft texture and slight sheen are valued far more than any ordinary fabric. This silk is a top-notch product that has a very fine texture with subdued gloss.

barterMaterials.name: Fine Fabric
barterMaterials.description: Light yet durable fabric. It's smooth and thin, and preserves heat well on top of that, hence its popularity. But it's sold at a high price because of its high demand.

barterMaterials.name: Finest Fabric
barterMaterials.description: Soft fabric with subdued gloss. Its thread is thin and yet the fabric is durable, thus commonly used in tailoring expensive clothes.

barterMaterials.name: Fine Leather Strap
barterMaterials.description: Leather strap made of high-quality leather. Made of well-tanned leather, it's soft without getting easily deformed or damaged.

barterMaterials.name: Finest Leather Strap
barterMaterials.description: Leather strap made of finest leather. It's durable as a bull's sinew but soft as silk.

barterMaterials.name: Tough Thread
barterMaterials.description: A very tough thread made out of a number of thin threads weaved in using the Weaving skill. Used for clothes or tools.

barterMaterials.name: Tough String
barterMaterials.description: A tough string made using Weaving skill by intertwining a number of thick threads. Used to make clothes or tools.

barterMaterials.name: Average Firewood
barterMaterials.description: Cut from decent quality wood, this firewood is lighter and smaller than your normal everyday firewood and tends to burn more efficiently.

barterMaterials.name: Fine Firewood
barterMaterials.description: Cut from fine quality wood, this firewood burns more efficiently than many other types of firewood. Sometimes, this type of firewood is used to make bows.

barterMaterials.name: Finest Firewood
barterMaterials.description: Cut from only the most solid and best quality wood, this firewood burns extremely well and is therefore amazingly efficient. Sometimes, this type of firewood is used to make bows.

barterMaterials.name: Special Firewood
barterMaterials.description: Firewood that burns quick and strong. Even more efficient than Finest Firewood.

barterMaterials.name: Copper Plate
barterMaterials.description: A plate made by refining a Copper Ingot. Used primarily as a material to make another item.

barterMaterials.name: Silver Plate
barterMaterials.description: A plate made by refining a Silver Ingot. Used primarily as a material to make another item.

barterMaterials.name: Gold Plate
barterMaterials.description: A plate made by refining a Gold Ingot. Used primarily as a material to make another item.

barterMaterials.name: Mythril Plate
barterMaterials.description: A plate made by re-refining a Mythril Ingot. Used primarily as a material to create another item.

barterMaterials.name: Glittering Paper
barterMaterials.description: This is a piece of paper coated with special glitter.

barterMaterials.name: Decorative Seafood
barterMaterials.description: This seafood is a popular status symbol in affluent homes. Because it can only be caught in the deep seas, it's very valuable. This can be traded for Ocean Tears when taken to the Trade Helper at Scathach Beach, which can in turn be sold in other towns as a trade good.

barterMaterials.name: Tough Lumber
barterMaterials.description: Rare lumber that's both tough and elastic. Perfect for making luxurious furniture and deadly bows. This can be traded for Alluring Stems from the Trade Helper at Scathach Beach, which can be in turn be sold in other towns as a trade good.

barterMaterials.name: Black Crystal
barterMaterials.description: A rare crystal found on Crystal Golem remains. It's dark now, but with a little mana it will glow again. Valued as a decorative item. This can be traded for Abyss Crystals from the Trade Helper at Scathach Beach, which can be in turn be sold in other towns as a trade good.

barterMaterials.name: White Crystal
barterMaterials.description: A rare crystal found on Crystal Golem remains. It's highly sought after for its ability to amplify the power of Alchemy Crystals. This can be traded for Sage Crystals from the Trade Helper at Scathach Beach, which can in turn be sold in other towns as a trade good.

barterMaterials.name: Sticky Sap
barterMaterials.description: A strange deep sea sap occasionally found on Sahagin. Due to its rarity, it's highly prized. It can be traded for River's Source from the Trade Helper at Scathach Beach, which can in turn be sold in other towns as a trade good.

barterMaterials.name: Shiny Leather
barterMaterials.description: The Shiny Leather of the Cave Sahagin. Take care not to ruin its radiant sheen. It can be traded for Night Sky Leather  from the Trade Helper at Scathach Beach, which can in turn be sold in other towns as a trade good.

barterMaterials.name: Deep-sea Fish
barterMaterials.description: This strange fish is unidentifiable. Popular amongst collectors of oddities. It can be traded for Unidentified Fish from the Trade Helper at Scathach Beach, which can in turn be sold in other towns as a trade good.

barterMaterials.name: Crystal Column
barterMaterials.description: A long, slender crystal. Can be forged into a crystal sword, said to bring good fortune. It can be traded for a Crystal Blade from the Trade Helper at Scathach Beach, which can in turn be sold in other towns as a trade good.

barterMaterials.name: Harmonious Cosmos Perfume
barterMaterials.description: A mysterious perfume used when combining the Fynni of different pets into one via Fynn Syncing.\nBrought to bloom by the fairies of Mag Mell, the calming fragrance of these special cosmos flowers is known to foster the natural harmony between different Fynni.

barterMaterials.name: Large Mythril Nail
barterMaterials.description: A large nail produced by melting down a Mythril Ingot. Sturdy and durable, it will hold even the most ambitious crafting projects together.

barterMaterials.name: Cotton Cushion Stuffing
barterMaterials.description: Cotton in the form of a cushion made by stuffing Fine Wool inside. It looks like you could use it to make something.

barterMaterials.name: Artificial Turf
barterMaterials.description: Nice-looking artificial grass made by bundling fresh grass with a tuft of flowers. It looks like you could use it to make something.

barterMaterials.name: Hay Bale
barterMaterials.description: A bale of hay made by bundling together Wheat Chaff and tying it all together with a Leather Strap. It looks like it could be used to make something.

barterMaterials.name: Emerald Fuse
barterMaterials.description: The Emerald Core's energy is stored in this fuse. Be very careful when you handle it...it's quite volatile.

barterMaterials.name: Energy Converter
barterMaterials.description: A part that can convert Shyllien energy to Hillwen energy and vice versa.

barterMaterials.name: Hillwen Alloy
barterMaterials.description: The hardest metal in Erinn.

barterMaterials.name: Spin Gear
barterMaterials.description: A Hillwen Engineering part that can produce a rotational device.

barterMaterials.name: Energy Amplifier
barterMaterials.description: A device that can amplify Shyllien energy instantly. Only Hillwen Alloy can withstand the amplification process.

barterMaterials.name: Shyllien
barterMaterials.description: A mysterious material made from a collection of extracted Shyllien Crystals.

barterMaterials.name: Purified Rabbit Foot
barterMaterials.description: A magic ingredient made from a purified mutant rabbit's foot.

barterMaterials.name: Sundew
barterMaterials.description: A magic ingredient made from purified mucilage of a Mutant Plant.

barterMaterials.name: Mysterious Herb Powder
barterMaterials.description: A mysterious powder that reeks of magic.\nIt's used as a special magic ingredient.

barterMaterials.name: Enchanted Firewood
barterMaterials.description: Special firewood bearing a special magic power.\nPerfect for making magic weapons.

barterMaterials.name: Mutant
barterMaterials.description: A bizarre material made by combining mutant animal specimens. It almost looks alive.

barterMaterials.name: Pet Playset
barterMaterials.description: A playset required to use the "Play With Pet" action.\nYou'll receive a special effect when you play with a pet.

barterMaterials.name: Finest Vanilla Scented Candle
barterMaterials.description: A scented candle that features a smooth vanilla aroma. A catalyst has been added to the fine candle to create a truly scent-sual experience. Its sweet scent will produce a special effect when you burn it in a campfire and rest nearby.\n\n* HP/MP/Stamina Recovery Speed +500%

barterMaterials.name: Lumen Syrup
barterMaterials.description: A bland-tasting syrup. Restores a tiny amount of HP.

barterMaterials.name: Blackberry Juice (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: Blackberry Juice produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. The moment you open the bottle, you can smell the sweet arome. Its strong blackberry flavor is a delight to any palate.

barterMaterials.name: Sweet Cake (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: A sweet cake produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. It is generously topped with whipped cream and fruit over two layers of well-baked, vanilla-flavored cake sheets.

barterMaterials.name: Red Pear Jam (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: Red Pear Jam produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. It is made by simmering finely chopped pears with plenty of sugar, preserving the sweet aroma and pulp of the fruit.

barterMaterials.name: Starry Salad (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: A Starry Salad produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. Fresh vegetables are tossed with olive oil and pepper, then accented with okra, ensuring a visually appealing vegetarian meal with a hearty taste.

barterMaterials.name: Jasmine Perfume (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: Jasmine Perfume produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. Its clean, elegant fragrance is beloved by many.

barterMaterials.name: Purple Fabric (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: Purple Fabric produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. The deep, subtle purple that only dyes made from natural sources can achieve, seems to shimmer and shift depending on the angle of the light.

barterMaterials.name: Floral Dress (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: A Floral Dress produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. The classic yet refreshing floral pattern accentuates the wearer's lively charm.

barterMaterials.name: Waterproof Fabric (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: Waterproof Fabric produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. Thanks to its specially treated surface, the fabric itself absorbs no water, remaining dry even when left submerged.

barterMaterials.name: Reinforced Fiber (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: Reinforced Fiber produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. This weave is so outstandingly durable that it's often used in the making of light armor.

barterMaterials.name: Evening Dress (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: An Evening Dress produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. This gown, which shines in the spotlight more brilliantly than any gemstone, is truly fit for those ladies who draw every eye when they enter the hall.

barterMaterials.name: Red Moon Earrings (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: Red Moon Earrings produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. The red gemstones, elegantly finished into pear-shaped droplets, have captured the hearts of many.

barterMaterials.name: Pure Blossom Hairpin (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: A Pure Blossom Hairpin produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. The pure white petals and the branch ornament carved from transparent quartz lend the wearer an air of sophistication.

barterMaterials.name: Midnight Pearl Paint (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: Midnight Pearl Paint produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. This dark, rich paint was inspired by and blended to resemble a starlit sky in the deepest hours of the night.

barterMaterials.name: Decorative Crystal Sword (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: A Decorative Crystal Sword produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. A fancy display piece in the shape of a longsword, it draws admiring glances when prominently displayed in one's home, rather than when drawn on a battlefield.

barterMaterials.name: Power Glue (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: Power Glue produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. Because it exhibits such incredible adhesive strength once it sets, one must be careful not to let any come in contact with one's skin.

barterMaterials.name: Natural Rubber (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: Natural Rubber produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. It is created by processing the latex sap of rubber trees, then further transforming the liquid into a solid chunk that can be used in a variety of ways.

barterMaterials.name: Pressed Flower Craft Box (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: A Pressed Flower Craft Box produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. This artistic handicraft is created by delicately arranging pressed flowers on a dark wooden box, then applying a special finish.

barterMaterials.name: Twilight Lute (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: A Twilight Lute produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. These instruments take their name from the sound their strings make when plucked, which some have likened to a fairy weeping mournfully in the twilight.

barterMaterials.name: Dawn Bow (Taillteann Farm)
barterMaterials.description: A Dawn Bow produced in a Magic Cauldron on a Taillteann Farm. Arrows fired from this bow are said to fly like rays of sunlight piercing the darkness at the first light of day.

barterMaterials.name: Magic Quill Pen
barterMaterials.description: A special quill pen created by channeling the energy of mana herbs into a vital feather.\nUsed to design Glyph Imprints.

barterMaterials.name: Magic Parchment
barterMaterials.description: A special parchment created by channeling the energy of mana herbs into soft parchment.\nUsed to design Glyph Imprints.

barterMaterials.name: Sturdy Loop
barterMaterials.description: A ring made from materials imbued with dark powers, making it extremely sturdy and hard to break. Used to craft special items.

barterMaterials.name: Azurite Plate
barterMaterials.description: A plate made by refining an Azurite Ingot. Used primarily as a material to make another item.

barterMaterials.name: Hematite Plate
barterMaterials.description: A plate made by refining a Hematite Ingot. Used primarily as a material to make another item.

barterMaterials.name: White Lead Plate
barterMaterials.description: A plate made by refining a White Lead Ingot. Used primarily as a material to make another item.

barterMaterials.name: Moonlight Gear
barterMaterials.description: A gear crafted with the Mana-Rich Heartwood. Used as a material for crafting rare items.

barterMaterials.name: Moonlight Rapids Grain Bread Box
barterMaterials.description: A box containing a large amount of bread made with rare ingredients.

barterMaterials.name: Rare Mushroom Stir Fry Box
barterMaterials.description: A box containing a large quantity of stir-fry made with rare Devil's Finger Mushrooms and Veiled Lady Mushrooms.

barterMaterials.name: Wild Berry Cream Sauce Box
barterMaterials.description: A box containing a large quantity of sauce made with a wild berry base.

guarantees.name: Ogre's Letter of Guarantee
guarantees.description: A Letter of Guarantee, issued by the Ogre, that assures the holder of the quality of the associated trade good. Using it gives up to 30% more Gold, EXP, and Ducats in profit from selling the trade good. When selling barter trade goods, you can receive 15% more from the total selling price. This letter has value as well, and grants 300 Ducats upon use.
